capture.description: Ignite a fire easily with the Coghlan's Flint Striker . This long-lasting fire-starting tool produces fire-igniting sparks for thousands of strikes. Made from ferrocerium, the rod easily emits sparks when scraped by the attached metal striker. Featuring a large handle for easy grip, this tool performs in all weather conditions and altitudes, ensuring you can light combustibles in any situation. .
